## Source
.design/m5/49-hardware-token-signing.md — REQ-5, AC-6 + decomposition PR 7.

## Surface
- `polaris-signer/src/fido2.rs` — FIDO2 PRF backend via `ctap-hid-fido2` (or current successor crate)
- Config: `[hwtoken] backend = "pkcs11" | "fido2"` selects the path
- Touch-per-sign: every signing operation prompts physical token touch; configurable timeout (default 30s).

## Rust-quality notes
- **`ctap-hid-fido2` is less mature than `cryptoki`** — verify current state before implementation. Spike if needed (similar to #155 TPM spike pattern).
- FIDO2 PRF derives the signing key from a per-credential salt — the keypair is bound to the FIDO2 credential, not to a separately-generated key. This shape is different from PKCS#11; the impl handles the deterministic-derive case.
- Per rust-quality §3: `PhysicalPresenceTimeout` (the variant from #164) is the explicit return on touch-timeout.
- Per rust-quality §10: touch prompt + sign-await is a sync operation (the FIDO2 HID transport is blocking). Wrap in `tokio::task::spawn_blocking` on the daemon side.

## External references
- `ctap-hid-fido2`: https://docs.rs/ctap-hid-fido2/latest/ctap_hid_fido2/
- WebAuthn PRF extension: https://www.w3.org/TR/webauthn-3/#prf-extension

## Acceptance (AC-6)
- [ ] FIDO2 token (or fixture) signs a payload after touch within 30s window.
- [ ] No touch within 30s → `SigningError::PhysicalPresenceTimeout`.
